# Syntax and selection validation do not depend on native retry support.
server start
! skygo run -f attempts.yaml
stderr 'attempt'
! skygo run -f exit.yaml
stderr 'exit'
! skygo run -f delay.yaml
stderr 'delay'
! skygo jobs logs nonexistent --attempt -1
stderr 'attempt'
! skygo jobs logs nonexistent --attempt 99
stderr '^attempt must be between 1 and 10\n$'
total-calls 0
calls SubmitRetryJob 0
calls SubmitJob 0
calls PlanTask 0
total-calls 0
skygo --json jobs list
! stdout '"id":'
! exists first second
server stop
! stderr .
-- attempts.yaml --
argv: [must-not-execute]
retry: {max_attempts: 11, exit_codes: [7]}
-- exit.yaml --
argv: [must-not-execute]
retry: {max_attempts: 2, exit_codes: [0]}
-- delay.yaml --
argv: [must-not-execute]
retry: {max_attempts: 2, delay_seconds: 3601, exit_codes: [7]}
